Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Garbage In, Garbage Out? Do Machine Learning Application Papers in Social Computing Report Where Human-Labeled Training Data Comes From? (1912.08320v1) · paper method: The authors limit inference to what publications disclose, not the underlying work; Twitter classification and mostly arXiv sampling may not represent other application areas, and the audit did not record actual agreement values or reconciliation/adjudication processes.

Permanent record ID: cohort9.claim.gigo.audit-limit

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Garbage In, Garbage Out? Do Machine Learning Application Papers in Social Computing Report Where Human-Labeled Training Data Comes From? (1912.08320v1) · paper method: Five student annotators initially labeled the same papers independently; weekly meetings reconciled disagreement by discussion, with the team leader deciding unresolved cases. After schema changes, all 164 papers were independently re-examined by at least two team members and reconciled again.

Permanent record ID: cohort9.claim.gigo.reconciliation
